GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

3. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   B. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   D. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   C. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Fishing as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   D. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
